item.description: A former Hamas fighter and drug addict, Abdullah's divine encounter with Jesus Christ shattered years of bondage. Now he shares his faith in spiritually hostile territory.

item.description: “I was in a season of isolation and without a physical church…and God used technology to reach me at the most difficult moment of my life.”

item.title: Caring for the Soul: A Virtual Retreat for Online Missionaries | Global Media Outreach
item.description: Every interaction with a seeker is a sacred opportunity to share Jesus. But we also know that pouring into the brokenness of others can be soul-stretching.

item.title: QA Engineer | Global Media Outreach
item.description: We are seeking a QA Engineer to join our Technology Solutions team. This role ensures the quality and reliability of our digital platforms through robust testing, automation, and documentation.

item.title: Data Science & Analytics Director | Global Media Outreach
item.description: As a Data Science & Analytics Director at Global Media Outreach, you’ll apply statistical modeling, machine learning, and data mining techniques to generate insights that inform outreach strategies, measure spiritual engagement, and optimize impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the organization to ensure data is used to advance our mission effectively and responsibly.

item.title: UX/UI Design Lead | Global Media Outreach
item.description: The UI/UX Design Lead serves as a critical bridge between marketing strategy and technology implementation. They translate brand vision and campaign goals into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences, ensuring that design decisions are both understandable to non-technical stakeholders and feasible for engineering teams.

item.title: Interview with Our New Russian Language Digital Ad Specialist
item.description: Our new Russian Digital Ad Specialist, Aylin, shares how she uses technology to reach seekers in closed regions and what keeps her motivated.

item.title: From Scrolling to Saving: A Digital Awakening in Africa
item.description: Across Africa, our Online Missionaries are meeting a spiritually hungry generation online, transforming crisis into stories of enduring hope.
